text: Yes, the 2022 loss was corroborated by the independent reference. The evidence shows that about 0.6 hectares of tree-cover loss within the asset in 2022 was mapped by Hansen/UMD and supported by the method. A later year was observed, and the JRC 2020 reference agreed on 100% of the event area. The MGAP 2021 forest map also confirmed that the event area was predominantly native forest, with 0.5 hectares mapped as forest and 0.1 hectares outside mapped forest.
